newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end down on weak cash.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end down on weak cash.

text.p: Reports of continued weakness in cash lumber kept CME lumber futures pressured at the close, traders said.
Lumber closed $1.50 to $6.30 per tbf lower with May off the least at $403.10 and July off most at $395.30 per tbf.

Rolling of positions out of May ahead of its limitless spot position Thursday provided some support, but all months showed pressure from the weak undertone to cash. Cash lumber is reportedly trading well under offical quotes, they said.
Random Lengths quoted cash spruce at $397 per tbf, off $2 from Friday and $9 under last midweek.
Private cash sources put cash lumber in the $382 to $387 area late Tuesday and saw little cash interest on Wednesday.
